questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T2 Bab 12 Sistem Suria

prompt.en: Earth is which planet from the Sun?

explanation.en: Earth is the third planet from the Sun.

questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T2 Bab 12 Sistem Suria

prompt.en: Earth is the only planet known to have liquid water on its surface.

explanation.en: Earth is the only place we know of with liquid water on the surface.

questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T2 Bab 12 Sistem Suria

prompt.en: About how much of Earth's surface is covered by ocean?

explanation.en: Oceans cover about 71% of Earth's surface.

questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T2 Bab 12 Sistem Suria

prompt.en: Earth has seasons because its axis is tilted.

explanation.en: Earth's axis is tilted about 23.4 degrees, which gives us seasons.

questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T1 Bab 9 Bumi (9.1 Sistem dan Struktur Bumi)

prompt.en: Put Earth's layers in order from the centre outward.

explanation.en: From the centre: solid inner core, liquid outer core, thick mantle, then the crust.

questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T2 Bab 12 Sistem Suria

prompt.en: Which gas makes up most of Earth's atmosphere?

explanation.en: Earth's air is about 78% nitrogen and 21% oxygen.

questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T1 Bab 9 Bumi (9.1 Sistem dan Struktur Bumi)

prompt.en: Match each layer of Earth to its description.

explanation.en: The inner core is solid, the outer core liquid, the mantle thickest, and the crust outermost.

questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T2 Bab 12 Sistem Suria

prompt.en: Earth is the largest of the rocky (terrestrial) planets.

explanation.en: Earth is the fifth largest planet and the biggest of the rocky planets.

questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T2 Bab 12 Sistem Suria

prompt.en: Why do we add a leap day every four years?

explanation.en: Earth takes about 365.25 days to orbit the Sun, so the extra quarter days add up to a leap day.

choices: The Moon pulls Earth off course

questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T2 Bab 12 Sistem Suria

prompt.en: Match each Earth fact to its number.

explanation.en: Sunlight takes about 8 minutes to cross the 150 million km between the Sun and Earth.

questions.kssm: KSSM Sains T2 Bab 12 Sistem Suria

prompt.en: Put these planets in order from largest to smallest.

explanation.en: Earth is 5th largest, Venus 6th, Mars 7th and Mercury the smallest.
